(4) HYPOTHESIS: lr 5e-3->1e-3 lifts hr above 0.2771 because a gentler step lets the bilateral sigmas converge more precisely to a better denoising point rather than overshooting into the fast shallow basin at 5e-3. FALSIFIER: if flat/drops, the sigma optimum is lr-insensitive and the architecture is at its ceiling ~0.277 -> remaining iters consolidate/confirm best config. (5) BUDGET: ep10 base ~500s, under 20-min. (6) Loop continues; iter-13 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
